request: Refine Fibriki first, then Lulia mini, comparing the result in the existing product lineup.
v1_findings: Paper already matches closely; a global background recolor would not fix the mismatch.
The Fibriki title was taller and darker, and its descriptor too prominent.
The left serving cluster was about 45% wider than the classic meatball reference.
The running hero chicken has a different drawing style, contrast and scale from the printed label illustration.
Orange central handwriting, glossy food, strong green accents and fresh garnish introduced a different hierarchy and palette.
fibriki_strategy: Edit the existing classic meatballs package with minimal changes. Preserve its physical geometry, paper, logo, printed flying-chef illustration and element positions. Replace agreed copy, keep food small and matte, use a small brown arc instead of a central orange slogan.
lulia_strategy: Only after the Fibriki family comparison is satisfactory, adapt the existing home-style cutlet package. Reuse its printed chef and tray, replacing food with small oval chicken sausages, with the same restrained print finish.
invariants: Transparent background and complete rounded tray rim
No invented weight, ingredients list, nutrition or production barcode
Existing products and hero compositions unchanged
Native images, exact prompts and rejected versions retained
